description: Audit one business workflow for bottlenecks, manual work, broken handoffs and automation opportunities. The plugin identifies likely root causes, assesses operational dimensions, recommends whether to fix the workflow first, use conventional automation, AI assistance, an AI agent, systems integration, custom software, or no technology change yet, and provides practical next actions plus what not to automate. It is read-only, requires no login, and does not change external systems.

defaultPrompt: Audit our client onboarding workflow and tell me what we should fix or automate first.
We build monthly reports manually across several systems. Audit the workflow and tell me what should be integrated or automated.
Should we use AI in our customer support reply workflow, or would conventional automation be better?
